title: Click TP
script:
loadstring([[
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()

local TeleportEnabled = false

-- GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
local Toggle = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)

Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 80)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0.4, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true

Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Click TP"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextSize = 18

Toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
Toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.45, 0)
Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
Toggle.Text = "OFF"
Toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Toggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Toggle.TextSize = 16

Toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    TeleportEnabled = not TeleportEnabled
    Toggle.Text = TeleportEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"
    Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = TeleportEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 60)
        or Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end)

Mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if not TeleportEnabled then return end
    if Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0,3,0))
    end
end)
]])()
